intent.raw: refresh the UI design and plan so required concepts can be implemented with synthetic calibration while real evidence measures confidence
intent.objective: Build and audit an eleven-concept development UI profile on the existing DomainSpec graph engine, then hand exact authority deltas to owners.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The user requested one streamlined run and every SWU has a strict sequential dependency; local Task Session continuation avoids a separate parallel-dispatch gate.

steps.name: Refresh and validate UI profile plan
stop_conditions: block if required vocabulary, representation placement, confidence, or authority status are collapsed

steps.name: Freeze required concept and representation contract

outputs.ref: validated UI profile registry and digest

stop_conditions: block missing concepts, unknown placement, alias/split invalidity, or authority mutation

steps.name: Implement formation contracts and synthetic calibration
steps.evidence_artifact: SWU-UIP-003 complete 11 x 6 synthetic calibration matrix
stop_conditions: block incomplete fixture classes, empty-value acceptance, or synthetic evidence mislabeling

steps.name: Compile and traverse with the existing DomainSpec engine

outputs.ref: compiled graph, views, traversal matrix, and typed endpoint residue

stop_conditions: block a parallel engine, implicit dev-profile activation, nondeterminism, or view mismatch

steps.name: Produce authority packet and integrated audit

outputs.ref: DS-D1, DS-D8, and supported-profile owner packet

stop_conditions: block canonical writes, incomplete owner coverage, failed aggregate validation, or empirical overclaim

gates.condition: Design, machine view, plan, layering, split work-pack, dispatch, and Distill result validate.
All eleven concepts have closed placements and complete synthetic calibration.
Explicit development profile compiles and traverses through the existing engine deterministically.
Development output emits a packet and does not mutate authority.

boundaries.contract: Execute one selected SWU at a time with strict context, declared write scope, and structured receipt.
Required vocabulary and mechanical evidence may prepare exact deltas but cannot activate canonical or release authority.

authority.validation: DomainSpec engine and UI profile contract owners

promotion_splits.source: required UI development profile and synthetic calibration
promotion_splits.target: DS-D1, DS-D8, supported profiles, and FPR-02
promotion_splits.rule: No development result or confidence receipt changes authority without its named owner decision.

promotion_guardrails: Required-by-design does not mean canonical active or release-admitted.
Synthetic calibration proves mechanics, not empirical universality.
All eleven concepts remain available even when represented as alias, role, projection, relationship, or split.
Real-corpus confidence cannot automatically add, remove, activate, or demote a concept.
FPR-02 remains a separate supported-release-profile decision.
